Counsel for Applicant :- Rehan Ahmad Siddiqui
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.182 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 302 IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Tarun, District Faizabad/Ayodhya.

3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that daughter of the informant was married to the nephew of the applicant on 18.05.2022 and sufficient dowry was also given, however, the matrimonial family used to make demand for additional dowry and on 04.06.2024, the son-in-law of the informant informed that the daughter has committed suicide.
The postmortem report on record indicates Raja Ram Chaurasia vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.

1 presence of three injuries on the head, based upon which, the applicant is sought to be implicated under Section 302 IPC also.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant, based upon the statement of the witnesses, states that the applicant is brother of father-in-law of the deceased and was having a separate living and in terms of the statement, he was not even present on the said date.
The charge-sheet has been filed against the applicant, his brother as well as his brother's son.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the applicant has a separate living and there is no specific allegation against the applicant of having caused the injuries which resulted in death, the applicant who is aged about 62 years and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Raja Ram Chaurasia be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 1.10.2024 nishant  Raja Ram Chaurasia vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.
